title: QR-ready HC1 output; no QR encoding in the library
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 10. Step 9 — Render the QR code; HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode; ISO/IEC 18004:2015 QR Code. HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode: “The Alphanumeric (Mode 2/QR Code symbols 0010) MUST be used in conjunction with Base45.”.

statements.label: QR-ready HC1 output; no QR encoding in the library
statements.requirement: The HC1 string SHALL consist only of characters in the QR Alphanumeric set (the Base45 alphabet and the "HC1:" prefix), so that integrators can encode it as a single Alphanumeric-mode segment with error correction Q using any QR encoder. The libraries SHALL NOT encode or render QR symbols.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-QR-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-QR-001 the output is a QR-ready string in the Alphanumeric alphabet` (PrefixContextTest.kt)).
